title: NIce, attractive pillow covers for your home
text: NIce, attractive pillow covers for your home. These are relatively inexpensive velour pillow covers. I use the on my white leather couch to add a pop of color to my family room. Soft and well made, the blue color is beautiful and vibrant. Normally, velour is not my go to fabric choice (reminds me of the 1970s) but these are pretty and will add a great dimension to your home.
